answer: Weigh trust by how a cluster connects to the rest of the network. Starting from a few known-honest seeds, run short random walks over the graph of paid jobs between agents. Honest agents sit in a thick web where walks thread in and out easily; a sybil spiral mostly trades with itself and links to real agents through only a few edges, so little trust flows in. Rewards follow trust received, so the forge can mint clones but not the honest edges.
